part.text:
All tests pass (18/18 via ctest). 

The fix, in `include/fmt/format.h`:
- `write_bytes` (include/fmt/format.h:1311) now takes an `align::type align = align::left` template parameter and forwards it to `write_padded`.
- The hex-float path (`float_format::hex`, include/fmt/format.h:1801-1805) now calls `write_bytes<align::right>`, matching the default right alignment of other numeric types.

Verified: `fmt::format("{:16a}", 4.2f)` now yields `'   0x1.0cccccp+2'` (right-aligned by default), while explicit `<`, `^`, `>` alignments and all 18 test suites (format, core, printf, enforce-checks, etc.) still pass.
